scientific_integrity: Analytic proof applies to every odd prime p and every power-of-two q>=4; exact integer cyclotomic tests independently reproduce full small-case histograms. Absolute publication priority and independent validation not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Not asserted for composite domain cardinality, non-dyadic codomains, or continuous groups.
Relevant older Hadamard-pair and mask-polynomial literature may contain an equivalent formulation.
title: Dyadic phase-divisibility classification of every exponential basis of prime-graph transversals
